goal: Prevent extreme relative ban times from overflowing integers and silently expiring immediately
Ensure setban and startup options reject or clamp outsized ban durations instead of dropping them
agreement: Support for rejecting or clamping values larger than any meaningful use case (maflcko)
Pointed out large settings.json values crash startup, author pushed an int64 cap fix (willcl-ark)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because outsized ban times cause signed overflow, silently dropping the ban despite reporting success
Fixes misleading RPC success returns on extreme values, though normal ban lengths are unaffected
